title_zh: 询问转行课程资助并找到资格清单入口

scenario.label_zh: 转行学习的资助条件询问
scenario.goal_zh: 说明求职和转行目标，了解资助并非自动获批且需核对条件，并找到资格清单的查看入口

context_zh: 虚构成人教育咨询练习中，求职者询问课程资助，不构成真实资助资格或财务建议。
author: author-phase09-a

sentences.speaker: Noel
sentences.text: I am a job seeker hoping to move into the arts sector. Is this course only for people who already work there?

sentences.speaker: Farah
sentences.text: No. It is designed for people changing careers as well.

sentences.speaker: Noel
sentences.text: I want to seek work in a gallery, but I cannot afford the full fee. Is there any help?

sentences.speaker: Farah
sentences.text: There is a scholarship scheme. It covers the course fee for some applicants, but places are limited.

sentences.speaker: Noel
sentences.text: Does being unemployed mean I automatically qualify for a scholarship?

sentences.speaker: Farah
sentences.text: No. You need to check the full conditions and submit an application. The eligibility checklist is linked at the bottom of the course page.

sentences.speaker: Noel
sentences.text: I can see the link. I'll read the checklist first rather than assume the fee will be covered.

targets.sense_zh: 有组织的计划；资助方案
